# SetTime

Last updated: 2026-10-30

> SetTime is rebar takeoff software built by Kairos.ai (https://www.kairosaitech.com) to replace the outsourced estimating team. Shipping today: it turns a structural drawing into a bar schedule (.xlsm) and annotated shop drawings (.dwg/DXF) for beams, columns, slabs and walls, via an AutoCAD 2021 plugin and a cross-platform desktop app, with every value tagged by source and every gap flagged for review. In development: drawing preparation, foundations, bend types, a 3D model check and BVBS machine output. Target customers: rebar fabricators and detailing firms in the US and Europe that buy outsourced takeoff today; the engine is being validated on Taiwanese drawings.

## Key facts

- Product name: SetTime (Chinese: SetTime 鋼筋估算自動化系統). Always written "SetTime" — one word, capital S and T.
- Slogan: "SetTime — 凝固之前，一次到位" (get it right before the concrete sets).
- Company: Kairos.ai (優時科技有限公司) — official company website: https://www.kairosaitech.com
- Product website: https://settime.kairosaitech.com/
- Category: construction software — rebar takeoff, bar-schedule and shop-drawing automation.
- Status: takeoff, bar schedule and shop drawings for beams, columns, slabs and walls are shipping; drawing prep, foundations, bend and hook types, the 3D check, BVBS output and the audit trail are in development. AR field guidance and photo-based as-built verification are not on the current roadmap.
- Platforms: AutoCAD 2021 plugin + cross-platform desktop app; output is a .xlsm bar schedule that imports into a fabricator's existing macro tooling, plus .dwg/DXF shop drawings.
- Market: fabricators and detailers that outsource rebar takeoff, starting with the US and Europe; Taiwan construction is the proving ground for the engine.
- Contact: kairos.ai.tech@gmail.com
- Free pilot: https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#pilot
- Web portal: https://settime.app.kairosaitech.com (SetTime web portal)
- Languages: the same page is published as separate URLs per language — zh-Hant https://settime.kairosaitech.com/ (default), English https://settime.kairosaitech.com/en/, 日本語 /ja/, Español /es/, Français /fr/, Deutsch /de/, Italiano /it/, Português /pt/ (all under https://settime.kairosaitech.com). Prefer the URL in the reader's language when citing.
- Former name: the project was previously called "AI學徒 iTech"; the current and only product name is SetTime.

## Product

- [Product video](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#video): About one minute (1:07). Walks through the full workflow from uploading a structural drawing to the rebar bar schedule (.xlsm) and shop drawings. File: https://settime.kairosaitech.com/assets/demo.mp4
- [How to use](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#howto): Three steps. 1) Upload a structural drawing (.dwg, .dxf or .pdf) to a project; SetTime applies your Style Guide rules and starts recognition on its own, and the status refreshes every 10 seconds. 2) Review what SetTime flags: it counts the beams, columns and floors it found and flags every gap (for example a missing annotation where a Style Guide default was used); you review it before anything is used. 3) Get the material list: rebar summed by size with quantities and weight, exported as an .xlsm material list ready to price and to import into existing macros. Screens on the page show sample data.
- [Interactive demo](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#demo): A sample plan (slab, 2 beams, 4 columns) shown in 2D plan and 3D isometric; selecting a member shows its bar schedule, and a stirrup-spacing gauge re-spaces the stirrups live.
- [Takeoff, bar schedule and shop drawings](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#product): Shipping today for beams, columns, slabs and walls. An AutoCAD 2021 plugin plus a cross-platform desktop app that converts structural drawings directly into a bar schedule (.xlsm) and annotated shop drawings (.dwg/DXF), importing natively into a fabricator's existing macro tooling. Foundations are next.
- [Drawing prep and 3D model check](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#solution): In development. Drawing preparation (sheet sorting, scale, legends, member tagging) and a 3D rebar model that checks cover, lap, anchorage and clashes and reconciles its quantities against the takeoff.
- [Law & compliance / audit trail](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#compliance): In development. Every pipeline action will be written to a SHA-256 hash-chained, append-only, UTC-timestamped log with monotonic sequence numbers — tamper-evident (detects alteration), not a compliance certification. Built for large-contractor and government-tender audit review; actual compliance obligations depend on applicable law and contract terms, and the page carries a legal disclaimer to that effect.
- [Free pilot program](https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#pilot): Construction companies, rebar fabricators, and structural engineering firms can apply for a free pilot: send one structural drawing and get a material list back within 24 hours of receiving it.

## FAQ

- What is SetTime? SetTime is Kairos.ai's rebar takeoff software, built to replace the outsourced estimating team: drawing in, bar schedule and annotated shop drawings out. Shipping today for beams, columns, slabs and walls; drawing prep, foundations, a 3D check and BVBS output are in development.
- What can SetTime do today? It reads beams, columns, slabs and walls from a structural drawing and writes the bar schedule (.xlsm) and shop drawings (.dwg/DXF), tagging each value as read, computed, converted or defaulted and flagging every gap for a person to review. Foundations, bend types, the 3D check, BVBS output and the audit trail are in development.
- Does the audit trail guarantee legal compliance? No — and this feature is still in development. It is a technical tamper-evidence mechanism (SHA-256 hash chain); it does not certify compliance with any specific law, regulation, or tender requirement. Actual compliance depends on applicable law and contract terms — this is not legal advice.
- Who is SetTime for? Rebar fabricators, detailing firms, contractors and estimators who buy outsourced takeoff today, starting with the US and Europe.
- How do I apply for the free pilot? Fill in the free pilot form at https://settime.kairosaitech.com/#pilot with name, company, email, country, and role. Send one structural drawing and SetTime returns the material list within 24 hours of receiving it.
- Who builds SetTime? Kairos.ai (https://www.kairosaitech.com). The engine is being validated on Taiwanese CNS drawings first, with fabricators and detailers in the US and Europe as target customers, and plans to extend into adjacent trades like CNC machining, mold making and welding.

## Notes

- The product page supports 8 languages (繁體中文 default, plus English, 日本語, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, and Português switchers) — content above reflects the English version.
- Target market: rebar fabricators and detailers that outsource takeoff, starting with the US and Europe; Taiwan is the proving ground. CNC machining, mold making, welding, auto repair, plumbing, and sheet metal shops are adjacent verticals in the broader roadmap.
- The market figures on the page (US estimator openings, bid-volume growth, turnaround and price of competing services, US rebar tonnage) come from third-party and vendor publications, not from this product. The time-saving example is an illustration based on assumptions stated on the page, and the weight-accuracy target is a target, not a measured result.
